description: This file defines the LicenseService class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing license entities such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and checking license names.

classes.name: LicenseService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic and data handling for License entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves a new or existing license.

methods.name: getLicenseDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LicenseDao object.

methods.name: setLicenseDao
methods.description: Sets the LicenseDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of licenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of licenses matching search criteria.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license name already exists, case-insensitive.
